{{Top|leg}}
'''Chugger's Chaw''' was a type of liquid foodstuff, possibly narcotic, available during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. One guard at the [[Chancellor Palpatine Spaceport]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] liked it. It was usually a light green in color.
